This loan, in addition to a down payment of {initialDeposit}, will finance a purchase in the amount of {purchaseAmount}. Subject to review and approval by Alma. Statutory withdrawal period of 14 days. Simulation provided by Alma, registered with the Nanterre Trade and Companies Register under number 839 100 575, a payment institution and financing company authorized by the ACPR under No. 17408 (CIB number / Bank Code).
